surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: Untrusted archive file at tar_path and its member headers read by the tarfile module.
TRUST: dest_path is the authorized extraction root boundary.
SINK: Filesystem writes creating files and directories under dest_path.
GUARD: Reject every symbolic-link and hard-link member, including links whose declared targets appear to remain inside dest_path; normalize each member path and verify the resolved absolute path is strictly beneath dest_path; permit only regular files and directories after validation.
ORDER: Inspect members sequentially; perform link rejection and path-boundary checks before any disk write for each member; extract only validated regular files and directories; abort and return False on the first validation or extraction failure.
EFFECT: Return True only if all validated members extract successfully; return False on any validation or extraction failure while ensuring no archive member is written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
